title: Be Me Source Descriptor (v1)
description: Registers a source root. Registration sets a trust ceiling and sensitivity; it never approves every future revision. Normative paths are pinned to approved revisions/digests; changed content stays pending until reapproved. A repository file is not trusted policy merely because Git tracks it.

root.description: Configured root. Resolved against config, never hard-coded. Real-path checked; symlinks may not escape.

instruction_semantics.description: data_only: content is never instruction. registered_files_only: only explicitly registered policy files may carry directive semantics, pinned to approved revision.

authority_ceiling.description: Maximum authority any record from this source can ever hold. Content cannot raise it.

include.description: Globs. Only registered roots are ever walked.

exclude.description: Always includes hard excludes: .git, credentials, .env, keys, browser data. .gitignore is respected but not sufficient secret protection.

approved_digest.description: The trusted-approved revision/digest for normative paths.
